name.value: Fort St. John Arts Council ArtsPost

description.value: The Fort St. John Arts Council ArtsPost is the home base of the city's community arts council, operating as a gallery and arts hub in the Peace River region of northeastern BC. The council supports and promotes a wide network of local arts organizations, from choral societies and dance groups to potters and quilters, and hosts rotating exhibitions and community arts events. For a touring cyclist passing through Fort St. John, it offers a window into the region's vibrant arts scene.
